html:
Latsen is a city in the center of Ollandia, on the Plyutva–Latsen–Mershants railway line. On the author’s map, three red arrows fan out from it: Kurtzleben’s army heads south, Brojenstoff’s north, and Hofmeyer’s southeast. The broadest arrow points toward Latsen from the western border, marking the invasion’s general direction, while a nearby black arrow is labeled “This is where Dietrich won the battle.”

Occupation (ch. 6)

The Dangarians captured the city roughly three months before chapter 6. The square is clean and a brass band plays, but there are almost no listeners, and only women wait for water at the fountain. Here Dietrich meets Olkha, while Major Klein of the Kaiser’s Claws receives him in the town hall.

Headquarters (ch. 25, 28, 31)

In chapter 31, Latsen is described as the country’s geographical center, whose capture split it into north and south. Field Marshal Reiniger has installed himself in the former assembly hall of the Latsen Voivodeship’s nobility; the generals’ conference also takes place here. In chapter 28, the Catalian general Deserey reports that the Plyutva–Latsen–Mershants railway is under construction, and that Kurtzleben’s and Brojenstoff’s armies are in the country’s center. According to chapter 25, Dietrich serves in Latsen, far from the fighting; in chapter 31, gendarmes arrest him at the station on Klein’s instructions.
